mechanics.name: Poised
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever a Generator is completed, suppresses your Scratch Marks for 20/25/30 seconds. The first time you start repairing each Generator, reveals the Killer's Aura to you for 8 seconds.
activation: A Generator is completed for the Scratch Mark effect.
Start repairing a given Generator for the first time for its Killer-aura reveal.
Ends/deactivates when: Scratch Mark suppression ends after 20/25/30 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The Killer Aura reveal ends after 8 seconds and does not trigger again for that Generator.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.2.0): Increased Scratch Mark suppression to 20/25/30 seconds and Killer Aura reveal on first repair of each Generator to 8 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Generator completions hide your Scratch Marks temporarily, and starting each Generator for the first time reveals the Killer briefly.
duration: Scratch Mark suppression: 20/25/30 seconds after each Generator completion.
Killer Aura reveal: 8 seconds on the first repair start for each Generator.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: The Killer Aura component triggers only on the first repair start of each individual Generator.

editorial.summary: The first time you start repairing each Generator, reveal the Killer for 8 seconds; whenever a Generator completes, hide your Scratch Marks for up to 30 seconds.
useCases: Use the first repair touch on a generator as an 8-second Killer location check.
Rotate safely after any generator completion with hidden Scratch Marks.
Combine objective play with passive information instead of sacrificing a slot to pure scouting.
counters: Each generator grants the Aura read only once.
Scratch-Mark suppression after completion matters only if movement and Killer proximity make it relevant.
Undetectable or Aura-blocking effects can reduce the information value.
pros: Strong passive value from normal objective play.
Eight-second Aura reads are long enough to guide real decisions.
Thirty-second trail suppression can cover an entire rotation.
cons: Aura trigger is one-time per generator.
Stealth half can be wasted by poor timing.
analysis: Poised deserves this position because its modern version quietly bundles two useful effects into ordinary generator play. Touching a fresh generator grants an eight-second Killer Aura read, which is enough time to decide whether the objective is safe before committing.

The second half triggers on any generator completion, not only one you finish. Thirty seconds without Scratch Marks can support a long rotation or a chase transition if the timing lines up with Killer pressure.

The perk is particularly good in Solo Q because it supplies information without requiring teammate coordination. You are rewarded for doing the main objective, and the information can prevent a bad repair commitment before the Killer arrives.

Poised stays in B because neither effect is under perfect player control. A generator can finish while you are nowhere near danger, and Aura denial can blunt the first-repair read. Still, the 9.2 buffs made it a much more complete perk than older rankings suggest.
editorial.verdict: A strong passive objective-information hybrid. Poised now gives enough Killer vision and post-gen stealth to justify a real build slot, especially in Solo Q.
